question: How do independently varied Source-to-Peer-HBM copy, Source-to-DRAM copy, Peer-HBM recovery, DRAM recovery, and modeled replacement duration affect healthy burden and same-probe failure WCT?
selection_policy: Execute and retain every registered direction, bandwidth, repair duration, policy, domain, and paired seed; no direction, seed, cell, or negative trend may be dropped by result shape.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA A100 40GB modeled as 40 GiB addressable HBM
hardware.placement: one TP1/PP1 replica per GPU; contiguous ranks in eight complete 8-GPU nodes
hardware.registered_s7_topology_reason: The fixed cross-node/remote route preserves committed replicas under source-node faults and makes copy versus recovery direction identifiable within the frozen 168-cell minimum plan. Same-node/local versus cross-node/remote topology is independently covered by S3; S7 does not select between them by outcome.

topology.peer_rule: same local GPU index on the next node in a node ring
topology.dram_rule: CPU DRAM attached to the next node in the same node ring

capacity_equation.no_oracle: dispatch must not inspect realized output length or realized service time

workload.probe_schedule: equal-width stratified timestamps over the common 90-180 s measurement window; timestamp and source-rank tuples paired across policies and every treatment for each seed
workload.primary_denominator: all workflows in the same 90-180 s measurement cohort for healthy and every same-probe failure replay

peer_hbm_recovery.primary_mechanism: fault recovery service and benefit-conditioned admission

dram_recovery.primary_mechanism: fault recovery service and benefit-conditioned admission

AegisKV.source_node: cross-domain committed replica uses fence activation; only no-survivor requests use replacement

statistics.interval: Student-t 95% confidence interval across seed-level paired differences (df=2)
primary: healthy all-workflow mean and p99 WCT
same-probe failure all-workflow mean and p99 WCT
absolute fault-WCT saved: Native Mooncake minus AegisKV
relative fault-WCT gain: 1 minus AegisKV divided by Native Mooncake
recovery service mean, recovery hit/coverage, normal-path copy burden, copy bytes/jobs/queue, reclaim, and capacity
statistics.performance_direction_gates: none; copy and recovery axes are not required to move in the same direction, and no minimum gain is required

figure_grammar.layout: 2x3 panels: absolute fault-WCT saved, relative gain, copy burden, recovery service, recovery coverage, and repair sensitivity
figure_grammar.panel_text_boundary: no preliminary, seed, hash, or evidence-boundary prose inside panels; those qualifiers remain in manifest and caption

hard_gates: exactly 168 preregistered cells are atomically published
all four direction labels and all five bandwidth values are retained without direction selection
only the registered table/key changes in each bandwidth treatment
workflow universe, measurement cohort, and probe timestamp/source tuples match across policies and treatments for each seed
source-worker failure invalidates exactly one rank and source-node failure invalidates exactly eight ranks
cross-node Peer-HBM and remote DRAM replicas survive source-node failure only when COMMITTED
policy-specific replacement versus activation contract is applied without a common delay
scheduled/controller copy bytes and physical target capacity conserve exactly
future or unsealed backup never blocks dispatch or participates in recovery
empty fault replay exactly reproduces healthy completion and fault replay never lowers WCT
no performance-direction, gain, seed, cell, or path-selection gate
single-page vector PDF, PNG width at least 1800 px, and extracted minimum font size at least 7 pt
evidence_boundary: Three-seed steady-measurement metadata DES sensitivity. The 40 GiB capacity equation and model bytes are frozen, but A100 directional bandwidth values, 500 ms fence activation, and 10/30/60/120 s replacement durations are modeled/unmeasured. Native Mooncake is a modeled Router+Store approximation. The fixed cross-node/remote S7 route is not a physical A100 measurement and is not paper-ready evidence.
